integrity: The proof contains rational analytic certificates reproduced by standalone CHECK.py; independent mathematical audit has not been performed. Imported Bessel bounds and spectral reduction are attributed.
scientific_limitations: Results cover finite real q>=9 and the planar radial-angular mixed norm; q=9 is sufficient and not optimal. No claims are made for 4<q<9, all pairwise Bessel order comparisons, or unmixed extension. Historical equivalent formulations may exist.
title: First-harmonic sharp circular mixed-Fourier stability for every real exponent \(q\ge9\)
